about_the_game:
Pixel-art focused map chip set
The "Modern Japanese School Edition" allows you to create detailed school facilities found in present-day Japan, including both reinforced concrete and wooden school buildings.

■ Highly detailed pixel art materials
Recreates the rich visual detail of modern Japanese architecture through carefully crafted pixel art.

■ Includes unique wall tile formats – create maps with a strong sense of depth
Custom wall tiles enable expressive and dimensional mapping.
Auto wall tiles compatible with RPG Maker standards are also included, making it easy for long-time RPG Maker users to adopt!

■ Beyond the standard classroom – a wide variety of room types
Includes tiles for specialized classrooms such as art rooms, music rooms, and lunch preparation rooms, allowing you to build a wide range of school scenes.

【Tilesets (13 sheets total)】

  • A2 Tiles: 2 sheets

  • A3 Tiles: 1 sheet

  • A4 Tiles: 1 sheet

  • A5 Tiles: 2 sheets

  • B to E Tiles: 7 sheets

【Object Character Chips (7 sheets total)】

  • Doors (48×72 pixels): 8 patterns

  • Doors (48×96 pixels, 7-frame animation): 16 patterns

  • Object set (On-air lamp, clock, classroom signs, ventilation fan)

  • Outdoor air conditioning unit (48×96 pixels): 3 patterns

  • Outdoor air conditioning unit (48×144 pixels): 2 patterns

  • Toilets

A sample project with map examples is also included.

------------------------------------------

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
